clues: Freshwater fish and hundreds of bird species share a shifting mosaic of water and land.
Numerous lakes and marshes provide habitats across this large river-mouth landscape.
Its importance comes from an extensive, well-preserved European delta rather than a single waterfall or gorge.
The river that builds it reaches the Black Sea after crossing much of central and south-eastern Europe.
Find Romania’s great World Heritage delta, where a major European river spreads into lakes and marshes before meeting the Black Sea.
targetLabel: Danube Delta — designated property reference point
modernContext: UNESCO’s published representative point for the designated property, not its uniquely correct centre.
explanation: The mystery concerns the river’s delta, not the whole river or an arbitrary point upstream. Its lakes and marshes support the bird and freshwater-fish diversity described by UNESCO. Use the published reference point for the designated delta; channels and shorelines extend well beyond that point.
dateLabel: First UNESCO World Heritage inscription year, not the age of the natural feature
cultures: Physical geography, conservation and scientific study
uncertainty: Source-checked authoring only; independent factual, English and clue-order review is pending. The point represents the designated property, not every part of a large natural feature. Source descriptions and dynamic environmental conditions may differ in date or extent; precise current measurements are not implied.
